name: ASTERIAL
releaseNotes: Major communication-first redesign across web and native Android: cleaner chat-first navigation, clearer hierarchy, quieter surfaces, and consistent spacing.
Refresh sign-in, sign-up, and first-run onboarding with clearer copy, welcoming motion, and a simpler account setup flow.
Refined conversation list and navigation visual language while preserving existing chat, Orbits, Moments, Feed, profile, and settings functionality.
Public-facing experience avoids source-code repository links; official product access and Android download remain on the product website.
